BatchRun.name: string
BatchRun.description: End-of-day batch execution session. Spans market close → NinjaTrader export → alerts → summary → archive.

mode.description: Execution mode: paper-only (PAPER), shadow-mode (SHADOW), or post-analysis (ANALYSIS)

correlation_id.description: Links batch to deployment candidate + Guardian verdicts

constraints: run_date must be trading day (no weekends/holidays)
correlation_id must match a deployment candidate
batch_status transitions: PENDING → PROCESSING → CLOSED → ARCHIVED
closed_at marks data immutability: no further modifications allowed

BatchVerdict.description: Final authorization verdict for batch execution. Aggregates Guardian 8-gate verdicts + compliance + tax + archive checks.
constraints: guardian_gate_results array must contain exactly 8 GateDecisionTuple entries
batch_status = APPROVED IFF all gates PASS AND compliance_passed AND tax_verified AND archive_verified
batch_status = BLOCKED if ANY gate BLOCKED or compliance/tax/archive verification failed
batch_status = NOT_PROVEN if ANY gate NOT_PROVEN

DayReport.description: End-of-day summary report. Aggregates trading activity, P&L, risk metrics, and alert counts.

risk_metrics.description: Risk data: {max_drawdown, var_95, sharpe_ratio, win_rate, avg_win, avg_loss}

alert_summary.description: Count by severity: {critical, high, medium, low}

constraints: pnl_summary must contain gross_pnl, net_pnl, currency, timestamp
risk_metrics must contain max_drawdown, var_95, sharpe_ratio, win_rate, avg_win, avg_loss
finalized_at marks immutability: no further modifications

AlertRecord.description: Trade alert or anomaly detection. Generated during batch processing; sources: risk monitors, compliance checks, anomaly detection.

report_id.description: Foreign key to DayReport (optional, if alert tied to report)

alert_type.description: Category: e.g., RISK_LIMIT_BREACH, DRAWDOWN_WARNING, ANOMALY, COMPLIANCE_FLAG, TAX_DISCREPANCY

context.description: Alert-specific context: {symbol, quantity, price, threshold, actual_value}

escalation_flag.description: If true, alert requires manual review

constraints: escalation_flag = true requires escalated_to be set
resolved = true requires resolved_at to be set

ComplianceBundle.description: Immutable compliance package. Locks tax summary, receipt hashes, and audit trail at batch close.

tax_summary.description: Tax data: {gains, losses, wash_sales, adjustments, total_taxable_income}

audit_trail.description: Chronological log of compliance checks performed

constraints: tax_summary must contain: gains, losses, wash_sales, adjustments, total_taxable_income
receipt_hashes array must not be empty
certification_time marks immutability: no further modifications
bundle_hash must match cryptographic hash of all fields

TaxDataArchive.description: Write-once, append-only tax data archive. Sourced from ComplianceBundle. Retained per regulatory requirements.

taxable_events.description: List of taxable events: {type, date, quantity, basis, proceeds, gain_loss}

retention_until.description: Date after which archive can be purged

constraints: No purge allowed before retention_until date

ArchiveRecord.description: Immutable archive entry in HP durable storage. Sourced from ComplianceBundle + DayReport. Read-only retrieval only.

retrieval_metadata.description: Metadata for retrieval: {format, size_bytes, created_date, archived_date}

constraints: archive_status transitions: WRITTEN → VERIFIED → RETRIEVED → PURGED
verified_at set only when archive_status = VERIFIED
No updates allowed after creation (INSERT only)
retrieval_metadata contains: format, size_bytes, created_date, archived_date

BatchRunTuple.description: Immutable snapshot of batch identity + timing

ComplianceBundleTuple.description: Immutable snapshot of compliance data at certification
ComplianceBundleTuple.example: (uuid-bundle-001, uuid-batch-001, {gains: 5000, losses: 2000, ...}, [hash1, hash2, ...], [{check: WASH_SALE, result: PASS, timestamp: ...}, ...], 2026-09-07T20:30:00Z)

ArchiveRecordTuple.description: Immutable snapshot of archived data in HP storage
ArchiveRecordTuple.example: (uuid-arch-001, uuid-batch-001, /durable/2026-09-07/batch-001.tar.gz, 7, sha256-hash-here, {format: tarball, size_bytes: 5242880, created_date: 2026-09-07, archived_date: 2026-09-07})

BatchVerdictTuple.description: Immutable snapshot of batch authorization verdict
constraints: guardian_gate_results must contain exactly 8 GateDecisionTuple entries
batch_status = APPROVED IFF all gates PASS AND compliance_passed AND tax_verified AND archive_verified

batch_to_verdict.description: Each batch has one final verdict
constraints: verdict must exist before batch closes

batch_to_report.description: Each batch produces one end-of-day report

batch_to_alerts.description: Batch generates zero or more alerts
constraints: alerts timestamped during [market open, batch close]
alert_count in report matches count of AlertRecords

batch_to_compliance.description: Each batch has one compliance bundle

batch_to_tax_archive.description: Each batch links to tax archive for retention

compliance_to_archive_record.description: Compliance bundle archived in HP durable storage

report_to_archive_record.description: Report archived in HP durable storage

verdict_to_guardian_gates.description: Verdict aggregates results from all 8 Guardian gates
constraints: batch_status = APPROVED only if ALL gates PASS
batch_status = BLOCKED if ANY gate BLOCKED
batch_status = NOT_PROVEN if ANY gate NOT_PROVEN

flow_steps.name: Guardian Gate Verdicts
flow_steps.constraint: All 8 gates must complete before batch can close

flow_steps.name: Market Close → Export
flow_steps.input: NinjaTrader trade log, account state, risk metrics

flow_steps.name: Alert Generation
flow_steps.input: Risk monitors, compliance checks, anomaly detection

flow_steps.name: Compliance Verification
flow_steps.input: Trade executions, account statements, tax calculations

flow_steps.name: Batch Verdict Issuance
flow_steps.input: Guardian verdicts, compliance verification, tax verification, archive verification
flow_steps.constraint: APPROVED only if ALL conditions met, authority=ZERO throughout

flow_steps.name: Archive Write (HP Durable Storage)
flow_steps.output: ArchiveRecord (immutable storage path, hash, HP receipt)
flow_steps.constraint: Write-once, append-only; HP receipt confirms durable write

flow_steps.name: Batch Close
flow_steps.constraint: After close, all batch data immutable

integration_points.constraint: Batch cannot execute without Guardian PASS on all 8 gates
Archive must be accepted by HP durable storage before batch closes

integration_points.provides: AlertRecordTuple → dashboard display, DayReportTuple → summary view
integration_points.constraint: Authority=ZERO must be visible; alerts are read-only on UI

authority_lock.name: NO_AUTHORITY_ESCALATION
authority_lock.enforcement: BatchRun.mode and BatchVerdict.authority_used must be ZERO at all times
authority_lock.test_case: If guardian_gate_results contain ANY authority!=ZERO, batch_status = BLOCKED

batch_immutability.name: BATCH_DATA_IMMUTABLE_AFTER_CLOSE
batch_immutability.enforcement: After BatchRun.closed_at is set, no updates allowed to batch, report, alerts, compliance, or archive records
batch_immutability.test_case: Any update attempt after batch.closed_at throws immutability violation

verdict_dependency.name: VERDICT_REQUIRES_ALL_GATES_PASS
verdict_dependency.enforcement: BatchVerdict.batch_status = APPROVED only if ALL 8 guardian_gate_results = PASS AND compliance_passed AND tax_verified AND archive_verified
verdict_dependency.test_case: If any guardian gate = BLOCKED or NOT_PROVEN, batch_status must be BLOCKED or NOT_PROVEN

guardian_gates_required.name: GUARDIAN_GATES_MUST_COMPLETE
guardian_gates_required.enforcement: BatchRun cannot transition to CLOSED without BatchVerdict containing all 8 GateDecisionTuple
guardian_gates_required.test_case: Attempting to close batch without complete BatchVerdict throws required_verdict_missing error

compliance_lock.name: COMPLIANCE_BUNDLE_IMMUTABLE_AFTER_CERTIFICATION
compliance_lock.enforcement: After ComplianceBundle.certified_at is set, no updates allowed
compliance_lock.test_case: Any update to tax_summary or receipt_hashes after certified_at throws immutability violation

archive_write_once.name: ARCHIVE_WRITE_ONCE_APPEND_ONLY
archive_write_once.enforcement: ArchiveRecord can only be created (INSERT), never updated or deleted. HP durable storage confirms write.
archive_write_once.test_case: Attempting to UPDATE or DELETE ArchiveRecord throws write_once_violation error

hp_durable_receipt.name: HP_STORAGE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED
hp_durable_receipt.enforcement: ArchiveRecord.hp_receipt must be populated before ArchiveRecord.archive_status = VERIFIED
hp_durable_receipt.test_case: Attempting to verify archive without hp_receipt throws missing_receipt error

retention_enforcement.name: TAX_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_ENFORCED
retention_enforcement.enforcement: TaxDataArchive cannot be purged before retention_until date
retention_enforcement.test_case: Attempting to purge before retention_until throws retention_not_met error

change_control.bugs_discovered: File issue, patch in PATCH release (V1.1)
change_control.clarifications: Add appendix, don't modify frozen sections
change_control.new_requirements: Wait for Phase 3, new major version (V2)

input_from_guardian.description: One verdict from each of the 8 Guardian gates
input_from_guardian.constraint: All 8 must PASS for batch APPROVED status

output_to_ui.description: Alerts and summary for dashboard display

output_to_archive.description: Immutable record for HP durable storage
output_to_archive.constraint: Write-once; HP receipt required before verification
